PluginData.Author: Oreo Systems
PluginData.Tooltip: WeaponCore target damage and Defense Shields HP overlay.
PluginData.Description:
Displays live Defense Shields HP for the current WeaponCore focus and nearby hostile grids, along with session damage dealt and locally recorded maximum NPC shield capacity.
Requires WeaponCore and Defense Shields on the server. Enable the Text HUD API client mod in Pulsar.
